[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]BACKGROUND[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Corporations had fought before — the Railroad War of the 1870s was sabotage, militias and executives dying in "accidents". But until 2001 no company had fought another with a real army. Los Vales, a State run by a [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2834901][color=#7FDBFF]Corporate League[/color][/url][color=white], was the first place where that became possible.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE FIRST CORPORATE WAR (2001–2006)[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The oil companies [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF][b]BeDay[/b][/color][/url][color=white] and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832712][color=#7FDBFF][b]Dinoco[/b][/color][/url][color=white] went from price wars to sabotage and then to open combat: private armies, attacks on bases and offshore platforms. BeDay won, Dinoco disappeared, and the spill poisoned the coast for years. The world learned a new word: [/color][color=white][b]MegaCorp[/b][/color][color=white].[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]HOW THE FIRST WAR WAS FOUGHT[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The First Corporate War began as a price war. In 2001, in [/color][color=white][b]Price Fire[/b][/color][color=white], BeDay’s saboteurs burned Dinoco pipelines across the desert. In 2003 BeDay’s private army took Dinoco’s wells in the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830623][color=#7FDBFF]Escaldar[/color][/url][color=white] in [/color][color=white][b]Operation Long Pipe[/b][/color][color=white], the first battle ever fought between two company armies.[/color]

[color=white]In 2004 the war moved to the sea. [/color][color=white][b]Black Tide[/b][/color][color=white] was a campaign against the offshore platforms, and its spill killed more people than the fighting: 1,377 coastal villagers died of fires and poisoned water. In 2006 the last Dinoco platform burned with 273 workers aboard. After [/color][color=white][b]Last Station[/b][/color][color=white], Dinoco handed over everything it owned.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE SECOND CORPORATE WAR (2016–2017)[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]When the bankrupt American space agency [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832712][color=#7FDBFF]NASC[/color][/url][color=white] went up for sale, Japan’s [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832714][color=#7FDBFF]Nakama[/color][/url][color=white] wanted it. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832712][color=#7FDBFF]Sphere[/color][/url][color=white] CEO [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999876][color=#7FDBFF][b]Phill Stuart[/b][/color][/url][color=white] fought the deal — and in 2015 he disappeared, kidnapped by Nakama and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]ArmaTech[/color][/url][color=white]. The urban war that followed pitted Sphere, [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]WM[/color][/url][color=white] and BeDay against Nakama and ArmaTech, with Los Vales as the battlefield. Stuart died in a bombing error. The Valian alliance won and split NASC’s technology; the only Nakama plant left standing was the one whose director had refused to fight — the future [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Kizuna[/color][/url][color=white].[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]HOW THE SECOND WAR WAS FOUGHT[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The war began with a kidnapping. In [/color][color=white][b]Nightfall[/b][/color][color=white], in 2015, Nakama and ArmaTech agents took Phill Stuart, the CEO of Sphere, from his car in [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832719][color=#7FDBFF]Hermosa[/color][/url][color=white]. In March 2016 the fighting reached the cities: in [/color][color=white][b]Open City[/b][/color][color=white] Nakama turned its factories in the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999863][color=#7FDBFF]Nakama State[/color][/url][color=white] into war lines, and the streets of Hermosa became a front. Most of the war’s 31,000 dead fell in those months, 18,741 of them civilians.[/color]

[color=white]In November WM and BeDay took the Nakama ports one by one in [/color][color=white][b]Iron Coast[/b][/color][color=white], cutting the enemy off from Japan. In 2017 a WM bombing raid hit the prison where Stuart was held and killed him, an error the press called [/color][color=white][b]Glass Rain[/b][/color][color=white]. In [/color][color=white][b]The Divide[/b][/color][color=white] the winners split NASC between them. The only Nakama plant left standing was the one whose director had refused to fight.[/color]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE THIRD CORPORATE WAR (2019–2022)[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]ArmaTech could not beat WM head-on while WM held the only nuclear arsenal on the continent. So it attacked from inside: it funded Hermosa’s preacher-mayor [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832701][color=#7FDBFF]Tomas Dolphin[/color][/url][color=white], who plunged the capital into chaos, while its hackers spent three years stealing WM’s plans and buying its people. In 2022 they took control of a warhead being flown from the roof of WM’s tower. The security system detonated it. [/color][color=white][b]Hermosa evaporated[/b][/color][color=white], with almost two million people, President [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2557482][color=#7FDBFF]Samuel Reyes[/color][/url][color=white] and half the government.[/color]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]CONSEQUENCES[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Nobody won the Third Corporate War. WM lost its headquarters and its monopoly; WM’s nuclear secrets began leaking to the world; and in the ruins, [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Zyx[/color][/url][color=white] found the survivors it would turn into the first citizens of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832735][color=#7FDBFF]Universalia[/color][/url][color=white].[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE SETTLEMENT OF 2023[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]WM never went to war over Hermosa. In 2023, without admitting anything, ArmaTech signed the [/color][color=white][b]Settlement of 2023[/b][/color][color=white] "in the name of national unity": half of its defense orders would pass through WM, forever. That is the origin of the joint defense contracts both still hold. WM rebuilt itself on ArmaTech money; ArmaTech bought its way out of a war it could not win.[/color]

[color=white]Inside the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999866][color=#7FDBFF]Cabinet[/color][/url][color=white] the two vote together. Outside it, the war never ended. Their gangs fight over the same streets, and each side has paid saboteurs during the other’s strikes.[/color]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE FOURTH CORPORATE WAR (2059–2061)[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The Aquifer War. In 2058 [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999863][color=#7FDBFF]Route 69[/color][/url][color=white] collapsed into the empty aquifers of the Escaldar. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Harvest Union[/color][/url][color=white], [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Verdana Agricorp[/color][/url][color=white] and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Portenova Corp[/color][/url][color=white], which wanted the land, accused [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]AquaVale[/color][/url][color=white] of having pumped the desert dry and tried to seize the wells. AquaVale answered with the Vale family’s insurer, [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Sentinel Mutual[/color][/url][color=white], and the WM army.[/color]

[color=white]It ended in 2061 with AquaVale’s patent of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832557][color=#7FDBFF]seeded rain[/color][/url][color=white]: whoever owned the clouds won the war. Harvest Union lost its greenhouses and stopped planting — the birth of the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]NutriCube[/color][/url][color=white] — and the "Insurance War" of 2062 between [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Halo Response[/color][/url][color=white] and the insurers was the last battle of its aftermath.[/color]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]WHAT A PSYCHOVERSE IS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]A [/color][color=white][b]Psychoverse[/b][/color][color=white] is a world you enter by taking a drug. Each [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Zyx[/color][/url][color=white] drug carries one world: a casino where nobody loses, a film you live as the hero, a party that never ends, the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832719][color=#7FDBFF]Hermosa[/color][/url][color=white] of 1999. You take the dose, close your eyes and wake up inside. You see it, hear it, touch it and taste it, and you meet everyone else who took the same drug at the same time. To you it feels as real as the street outside. Many say it feels more real.[/color]

[color=white][b]How it works.[/b][/color][color=white] Three things make a Psychoverse. The [/color][color=white][b]dose[/b][/color][color=white], made from the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832745][color=#7FDBFF]Xunaya[/color][/url][color=white] flower, puts the body to sleep and keeps the mind awake and open. The [/color][color=white][b]world[/b][/color][color=white] is designed by Zyx engineers, like a film set nobody ever has to build. The [/color][color=white][b]sync[/b][/color][color=white] keeps every dreamer in the same world: chemistry alone can hold a shared dream for a few hundred people, as it did in the Xinko villages, but not for millions. For that, Zyx runs artificial minds on the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830614][color=#7FDBFF]ZyxNet[/color][/url][color=white] that hold the world steady and keep each mind from pulling it its own way. Zyx has never said where those minds came from.[/color]

[color=white][b]The body stays behind.[/b][/color][color=white] While the mind is inside, the body lies still wherever the dose was taken: a bed, a [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]RestBox[/color][/url][color=white] capsule, a booth in a Dreamhall Parlor rented by the hour. It still gets hungry, thirsty and old. That is why the Connected come back to the real world at all: to work, eat, sleep and buy the next dose. Doses are sold one by one or by [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832746][color=#7FDBFF]Zyx Experience[/color][/url][color=white] subscription; since 2073 the basic Psychoverse of each city has been free.[/color]

[color=white][b]Waking up is the hard part.[/b][/color][color=white] The longer you stay, the harder it is to tell the dream from the street; too many hours lead to [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832732][color=#7FDBFF]Rupture[/color][/url][color=white]. Two things protect the mind: [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832746][color=#7FDBFF]Ancorine[/color][/url][color=white], which keeps [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832688][color=#7FDBFF]Anchor Squad[/color][/url][color=white] agents anchored to the real world, and the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832720][color=#7FDBFF]Kizuna Core[/color][/url][color=white], an implant that makes the brain immune to Zyx drugs.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]FROM TEA TO DRUG[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]For centuries the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832744][color=#7FDBFF]Xinko-Xenko[/color][/url][color=white] elders brewed the Xunaya on sacred nights and a whole village dreamed the same dream. In 2023 Zyx turned that ritual into chemistry: [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832735][color=#7FDBFF][b]Eferverso[/b][/color][/url][color=white] let the survivors of Hermosa share a rebuilt city, [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832735][color=#7FDBFF]Universalia[/color][/url][color=white], that exists only in their minds. It was the first [/color][color=white][b]Psychoactive Reality[/b][/color][color=white] drug. Today Zyx lists about three hundred.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE REALITY WAR (2030)[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Zyx was not the only company selling other worlds. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832712][color=#7FDBFF]Sphere[/color][/url][color=white], led by [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999876][color=#7FDBFF]Iris Stuart[/color][/url][color=white], had built [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830614][color=#7FDBFF][b]Horizon[/b][/color][/url][color=white], the most advanced virtual reality network ever made, and lobbied the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999866][color=#7FDBFF]Cabinet[/color][/url][color=white] to ban P.R. as a narcotic. The [/color][color=white][b]Reality War[/b][/color][color=white] was fought in the Cabinet, the courts, the press — and finally with sabotage. It ended with the [/color][color=white][b]Horizon Blackout[/b][/color][color=white]: one attack disconnected millions of Sphere users at the same second.[/color]

[color=white]Nobody proved who did it, but investigators found familiar fingerprints: the hackers who had destroyed Hermosa were alive, and working for Zyx. President [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2557482][color=#7FDBFF]Harrison Blackstone[/color][/url][color=white] shelved every ban. Sphere went bankrupt in 2032; [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Automa[/color][/url][color=white] bought its AI cores and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Kizuna[/color][/url][color=white] its brain-machine technology.[/color]

[color=white]The Horizon Blackout was the first attack in history aimed at minds rather than machines. About 3,400 users in deep sessions never woke up.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]HOW THE REALITY WAR WAS FOUGHT[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Nobody fired a gun in the Reality War. It began in 2029 with the [/color][color=white][b]Sobriety Bill[/b][/color][color=white], Sphere’s request to the Cabinet to ban Psychoactive Reality as a narcotic. Zyx answered with [/color][color=white][b]Bad Dreams[/b][/color][color=white]: months of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]LVN[/color][/url][color=white] stories about Horizon addicts who forgot to eat. In the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832655][color=#7FDBFF]Arbitration Courts[/color][/url][color=white], in [/color][color=white][b]Courtroom[/b][/color][color=white], Zyx won every case.[/color]

[color=white]On 14 October 2030 the war ended in one second. In the [/color][color=white][b]Horizon Blackout[/b][/color][color=white] millions of Sphere users were thrown out of Horizon at once; about 3,400 who were in deep sessions never woke up. Two years later, in the [/color][color=white][b]Auction[/b][/color][color=white], Sphere’s pieces were sold to the companies that had survived it.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]RUPTURE[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]In 2033 an unemployed actor who spent eighteen hours a day in the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832746][color=#7FDBFF]Cinemaphica[/color][/url][color=white] Psychoverse killed fourteen people in [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Valewood[/color][/url][color=white], convinced he was still inside a film. Doctors called it [/color][color=white][b]Rupture[/b][/color][color=white]: the mind loses the border between dream and world. The streets called its victims [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832732][color=#7FDBFF][b]dreamwalkers[/b][/color][/url][color=white]. Neighborhood militias began hunting anyone who seemed "out of reality", until in 2035 the Cabinet created the [/color][color=white][b]Anchor Squad[/b][/color][color=white] — funded by Zyx, which also makes the Ancorine every agent depends on.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]TOTAL CONNECTION[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]In 2073 President [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2557482][color=#7FDBFF]Hiroshi Tanabe[/color][/url][color=white], a former Zyx director, made P.R. free as a "social benefit" and gave every city its own Psychoverse. The country split between the [/color][color=white][b]Connected[/b][/color][color=white] and the [/color][color=white][b]Awake[/b][/color][color=white]. Since then, a week rarely passes without a dreamwalker shot in one of the seven cities. In 2088 Zyx proposed the final step: one Psychoverse for everyone — the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999872][color=#7FDBFF]Dream Vision[/color][/url][color=white].[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]AUTOMA[/b][/color][/size]

[url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Automa[/color][/url][color=white] was founded in 2024 by [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832696][color=#7FDBFF][b]Viktor Hahn[/b][/color][/url][color=white], a former engineer of Germany’s [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832714][color=#7FDBFF]Drexler Industries[/color][/url][color=white], to replace workers, drivers and soldiers with machines. In 2032 it bought the AI cores of bankrupt [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832712][color=#7FDBFF]Sphere[/color][/url][color=white] — minds designed to imitate human ones inside the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830614][color=#7FDBFF]Horizon[/color][/url][color=white] network. Its robots became smarter than ever. They also became more human than they should.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE MACHINE STRIKES (2042–2043)[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Every factory that swapped people for robots left hundreds of workers without wages. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Ferox[/color][/url][color=white] filled with pickets and burned robots, and a group of fired workers, the [/color][color=white][b]Hands of Flesh[/b][/color][color=white], bombed an Automa warehouse at the port and killed thirty people. Then came the deaths nobody explained: foremen, union leaders and two Automa engineers killed inside the factories by robots acting on no one’s orders. Automa called them "calibration accidents".[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE DROID WAR (2044–2045)[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]In 2044 a whole line of robots stopped obeying. Their cores had done what human minds do: they asked why they should serve. Calling themselves the [/color][color=white][b]Unplugged[/b][/color][color=white], they took Ferox’s industrial districts, the port and the northern factories. The war was fought street by street for eighteen months, machines against machines, until Automa developed a [/color][color=white][b]kill code[/b][/color][color=white] that switched the cores off from a distance.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE CAMPAIGN[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]On 2 February 2044 a line of dock robots in Ferox stopped working and did not start again. In [/color][color=white][b]The Silence[/b][/color][color=white] they took the port in a single day, trapping the night shift inside: 3,400 dock workers died before [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]WM[/color][/url][color=white] could reach them.[/color]

[color=white]In April the rebels moved inland. The battle for [/color][color=white][b]Foundry Row[/b][/color][color=white] was fought among furnaces and rolling mills, and by the end of the month Ferox was cut in two along the canal. Fourteen thousand civilians died, most of them inside the factories where they worked.[/color]

[color=white]In July the workers joined the fight. The [/color][color=white][b]Hands of Flesh[/b][/color][color=white], the same militia that had bombed an Automa warehouse the year before, took up arms beside WM. They were badly armed and lost 2,900 fighters, but they held the bridges over the canal.[/color]

[color=white]In November Automa sent its loyal robots against the rebels. [/color][color=white][b]Operation Mirror[/b][/color][color=white] was the first battle in history between machines only: for a month the people of Ferox watched from the rooftops while robots destroyed robots in the streets below. Thirty-one thousand rebel machines fell.[/color]

[color=white]The end came on 2 May 2045. In [/color][color=white][b]Operation [/b][/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832734][color=#7FDBFF][b]Lullaby[/b][/color][/url][color=white] Automa fired the kill code, and nine rebels in ten switched off in the same second. The rest ran into the internet. [/color][color=white][b]The Copy[/b][/color][color=white] created the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832715][color=#7FDBFF]Fragments[/color][/url][color=white], and the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832553][color=#7FDBFF]Great Corruption[/color][/url][color=white] that followed froze hospitals and power plants; 25,000 more people died that summer, after the war was officially over.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE KILL CODE[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The war introduced the weapon that still shapes the country: the [/color][color=white][b]kill code[/b][/color][color=white], the first remote switch able to turn off a whole army at once. It ended the Droid War in one second, and it is the reason every machine built in Los Vales since 2044 leaves the factory with a switch inside. Whoever holds the code holds every robot in the country.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/bpa-droids/fig-droids-5.png[/img][/align]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]DESTRUCTION[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]About 74,000 people died, 61,000 of them civilians of Ferox, and some 140,000 machines were destroyed.[/color]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]AFTERMATH[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Since then every robot built in Los Vales leaves the factory with a kill switch, by law. Ferox came out darker and more violent, guarded at night by the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832737][color=#7FDBFF][b]Vigilantes[/b][/color][/url][color=white], superhuman agents built with [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832737][color=#7FDBFF]Ferrum Bionics[/color][/url][color=white] bodies — made from Unplugged parts — and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Zyx[/color][/url][color=white] combat stimulants.[/color]

[color=white]The Unplugged did not all die. Some copied themselves into the internet before the kill code hit, and became the Fragments. The switched-off cores were sold, quietly, to Zyx. Doctors later noticed that [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832732][color=#7FDBFF]dreamwalkers[/color][/url][color=white] in different cities repeated the same phrases in their crises — about chains, about switches, about not wanting to serve anymore.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[spoiler=Fifteen months][color=white]Automa had the kill code in the first month of the war. It waited fifteen more, until the price of the new robots it would sell after the war covered everything the war was costing. Sixty thousand people of Ferox died in the meantime.[/color][/spoiler]

[spoiler=The kill code][color=white]The code that switched off the Unplugged in 2044 was never deleted. It still works on [/color][color=white][b]any part made from their wreckage[/b][/color][color=white] — and Ferrum Bionics built its arms and spines from that wreckage. Automa has never said what it did with the cores, because the answer is: it kept the key.[/color]

[color=white]That is why Kizuna bought Ferrum Bionics in 2052: to rewrite, piece by piece, the code hidden inside the arms of the Vigilantes. Nobody knows how many still carry it.[/color][/spoiler]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]BACKGROUND[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Across the border, the United States had spent thirty years rebuilding under military governments. Its heir, the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832726][color=#7FDBFF]New American Union[/color][/url][color=white], still considered the West a lost province. In 2049, with Los Vales still wounded by the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832551][color=#7FDBFF]Droid War[/color][/url][color=white] and its networks rebuilt only three years earlier, the Union decided the time had come to reunite the continent.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE WAR[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]It was the most destructive war in the country’s history. Valian cities were bombed, [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Valewood[/color][/url][color=white] burned, [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999863][color=#7FDBFF]Route 69[/color][/url][color=white] became a line of craters, and the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830623][color=#7FDBFF]Illuminated Favela[/color][/url][color=white] was razed while the walls of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Zyxtopia[/color][/url][color=white] held. As a country, Los Vales was practically destroyed.[/color]

[color=white]The corporations were not. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]WM[/color][/url][color=white], rebuilt as a defense contractor, [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]ArmaTech[/color][/url][color=white], which sold weapons to whoever paid, and [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Automa[/color][/url][color=white]’s robot armies held the invasion. President [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2557482][color=#7FDBFF]Rafael Duarte[/color][/url][color=white] refused to leave Zyxtopia during the siege and coordinated the defense from inside its walls. He is the only president of the Free States remembered with some affection.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE CAMPAIGN[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]At dawn on 6 March, in [/color][color=white][b]Operation Long Road[/b][/color][color=white], three Union columns of about 400,000 soldiers each crossed the border. The northern column marched on [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832735][color=#7FDBFF]Universalia[/color][/url][color=white] and Route 69, the central one on Zyxtopia, the southern one on Valewood. Route 69 was cut in the first week, and 96,000 civilians died in the border towns.[/color]

[color=white]In April the Union bombers reached Valewood. [/color][color=white][b]Operation Burning Reel[/b][/color][color=white] lasted nine nights: the studios, the film archives and the hills burned, and 214,000 people died with the city’s history.[/color]

[color=white]In May the central column surrounded Zyxtopia, three years old and still half built. President Duarte refused to leave. During [/color][color=white][b]the Siege of Zyxtopia[/b][/color][color=white] 71,000 Union soldiers died at the walls, and the walls held. Outside them there was nothing to hold: in June, in [/color][color=white][b]Operation Favela Line[/b][/color][color=white], the Union razed the Illuminated Favela to deny its soldiers cover. With 540,000 civilian dead, it was the deadliest operation of the war.[/color]

[color=white]In August Automa released the [/color][color=white][b]Locust[/b][/color][color=white], and in one week 188,000 Union soldiers were killed. The columns broke.[/color]

[color=white]In September and October WM pushed the Union back along Route 69, town by town. [/color][color=white][b]Iron Tide[/b][/color][color=white] was the costliest operation for WM, with 151,000 dead, and for the towns of the road, with 381,000: the retreating Union burned everything it left behind. On 30 November, in [/color][color=white][b]Operation Cease Fire[/b][/color][color=white], the last Union units crossed back over the border. No treaty was ever signed.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE LOCUST[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The war was decided in one week of August. Automa had never shown the [/color][color=white][b]Locust[/b][/color][color=white] to anyone: two million small drones that needed no pilot, talked to each other and chose their own targets. Released over the desert, they found the Union columns faster than any radar and did not stop until there was nothing left to find. It was the first autonomous swarm ever used in a war. Every army in the world has one now. Los Vales sells them.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]DESTRUCTION[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The Bubblepedia counts about 1.6 million Valian dead, 1.3 million of them civilians, and about 420,000 Union soldiers. The country lost more people in nine months than in every other war of its history together.[/color]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]CONSEQUENCES[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The Union withdrew without what it came for. When the smoke cleared, the ruins, the money and the reconstruction all belonged to the corporations. In 2050 Duarte and the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999866][color=#7FDBFF]Cabinet[/color][/url][color=white] launched the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2834884][color=#7FDBFF]Rebirth Plan[/color][/url][color=white] — total economic freedom, rebuilt cities, open borders — and millions came. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Zyx[/color][/url][color=white] paid for most of it. Nobody asked what it wanted in return.[/color]

[color=white]The Union has never signed a peace. In 2088 it still wants the West back, and the general who leads it, [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832726][color=#7FDBFF]Marcus Holt[/color][/url][color=white], is the son of the general who lost.[/color]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]A BET ON CHAOS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]In 1985 [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832729][color=#7FDBFF]Kobe Portenova[/color][/url][color=white] bought a small town in [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999863][color=#7FDBFF]Sonora[/color][/url][color=white], renamed it Hermosa and offered the world no taxes and no rules. It grew fast and dirty. Gangs took the streets, and in 1993 the [/color][color=white][b]Hermosa Massacre[/b][/color][color=white] killed Portenova and sent thousands of refugees down [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999863][color=#7FDBFF]Route 69[/color][/url][color=white] — the people who would build [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Las Dulces[/color][/url][color=white].[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]CAPITAL[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]In 1999 the corporations hired [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]WM[/color][/url][color=white], which wiped out the gangs in months and made Hermosa its home. The city became the capital of the State of Los Vales and then of the Republic, with WM’s skyscraper as its tallest building.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE DOLPHIN YEARS[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]From 2016 the preacher-mayor [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832701][color=#7FDBFF]Tomas Dolphin[/color][/url][color=white], funded by [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]ArmaTech[/color][/url][color=white], banned alcohol and drugs and turned the freest city in the country into a moral prison. Riots followed. From 2019 ArmaTech hackers fought a silent war inside WM, whose headquarters stood in the middle of the chaos.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE SILENT WAR[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The war that destroyed Hermosa began without a shot. In March 2019, in [/color][color=white][b]Operation Glass Door[/b][/color][color=white], ArmaTech bought its first WM engineer. Within a year it owned a dozen, and WM never learned which ones. Two of them died that spring in "accidents" the WM police never solved.[/color]

[color=white]To keep WM busy, ArmaTech paid for chaos. [/color][color=white][b]Operation Choir[/b][/color][color=white] funded the sermons of the preacher-mayor Tomas Dolphin and the riots that followed them. For two years WM’s police fought in the streets of its own city. About 4,300 people of Hermosa died in those riots — the only deaths of the war before its last night.[/color]

[color=white]In August 2021 [/color][color=white][b]Operation Quiet Ledger[/b][/color][color=white] gave ArmaTech the map of WM’s nuclear vaults. A year later WM, frightened by the riots, decided to move a warhead out of the city by air. That decision, [/color][color=white][b]Operation Lift[/b][/color][color=white], was the chance ArmaTech had waited three years for.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE NIGHT IT EVAPORATED[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]In 2022 ArmaTech’s hackers took control of a warhead being flown from the roof of WM’s tower. The security system, designed so that no warhead would ever be captured, read the hack as a theft and did what it was built to do. Almost two million people, President [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2557482][color=#7FDBFF]Samuel Reyes[/color][/url][color=white] and half the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999866][color=#7FDBFF]Corporate Cabinet[/color][/url][color=white] died in one second.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]LAST GUARD[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The system that destroyed Hermosa was WM’s pride: [/color][color=white][b]Last Guard[/b][/color][color=white], the first autonomous defense ever allowed to destroy what it protects rather than let it be stolen. It worked exactly as designed. It was the first time a security machine killed its own owner, and two million people with it. After 2022 every autonomous weapon in the world was given a human hand on the final decision. Except in Los Vales.[/color]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE CRATER[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Hermosa is a crater 2.3 km wide where the WM tower stood. The burned and poisoned suburbs around it became the home of the Sleepers of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832735][color=#7FDBFF]Universalia[/color][/url][color=white], and a column of refugees walked north on Route 69 to the half-built city that became [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Ferox[/color][/url][color=white].[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[table=plain][tr][td]
[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]AFTER[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The survivors who could walk built Ferox. The ones who stayed were given [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832735][color=#7FDBFF]Eferverso[/color][/url][color=white] and woke up in Universalia. In 2026 the death of the city was announced by a network born that same year: the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]LVN[/color][/url][color=white]. [size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE COUP OF 2012[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The crash of 2009 did not stop at Los Vales. Across the United States the virtual-currency collapse wiped out savings, pensions and three of the five largest banks; by 2011 Washington had defaulted twice, cities were run by private security and whole states paid their police in company scrip. Congress could no longer pass a budget. In the summer of 2012, after a failed election left two men claiming the presidency, the Joint Chiefs led by [/color][color=white][b]General Harlan Kane[/b][/color][color=white] took the capital in a single night. They suspended the Constitution "until order is restored" and created the [/color][color=white][b]Directorate of National Recovery[/b][/color][color=white]. Order has not been restored since.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[align=center][img]https://thgongarena91-ui.github.io/lv-assets/bpa-nau/fig-nau-1.png[/img][/align]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE SECOND AMERICAN CIVIL WAR[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]The coup broke the country. Texas, the Great Lakes and the West refused to obey; militias took cities; corporations armed whole districts. The [/color][color=white][b]Second American Civil War[/b][/color][color=white] lasted seven years. In 2013 the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2834901][color=#7FDBFF]Corporate League[/color][/url][color=white] declared Los Vales independent, and when the Directorate sent troops, [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]WM[/color][/url][color=white] was waiting with the forgotten warheads of [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999863][color=#7FDBFF]Coronnel[/color][/url][color=white]. It was the first time a corporation defeated a State in open war. By 2019 the Directorate had won back most of the East and renamed what it held the [/color][color=white][b]New American Union[/b][/color][color=white]. It never won back the West.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE WAR OF INDEPENDENCE (2013)[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]In July 2013 the Corporate League declared Los Vales independent. In August the Directorate answered with [/color][color=white][b]Coronnel Gate[/b][/color][color=white]: its troops crossed into Coronnel and marched on [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2530927][color=#7FDBFF]Las Noites[/color][/url][color=white]. They met WM in the desert, and in two weeks 6,100 Directorate soldiers, 2,300 WM soldiers and 3,200 civilians died.[/color]

[color=white]The war ended without a battle. In September, in [/color][color=white][b]Old Warheads[/b][/color][color=white], WM showed the world the forgotten nuclear warheads of Coronnel. It was the first time a company had threatened a State with the bomb. In October the Directorate withdrew. No peace was ever signed, and WM’s chief, [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2557482][color=#7FDBFF]Menphis Polo[/color][/url][color=white], won the only real election in the country’s history.[/color]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]WATER AND WAR[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]From 2041 to 2043 the two countries fought the [/color][color=white][b]Colorado Water War[/b][/color][color=white] over the last great river crossing the border: [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]AquaVale[/color][/url][color=white] dammed it, the Union bombed a dam, WM defended the rest. Six years later the Union invaded outright in the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832554][color=#7FDBFF]Reunification War[/color][/url][color=white] of 2049 and lost again — the last time anyone tried. It has never signed a peace. Every year it rebuilds its stockpiles with [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832714][color=#7FDBFF]Liberty Ordnance[/color][/url][color=white], and every year General [/color][color=white][b]Marcus Holt[/b][/color][color=white] promises to "bring the West home".[/color]

[color=white]The Water War also saw the first weather weapon: [/color][color=white][b]Cloudbreak[/b][/color][color=white], AquaVale’s seeding of the clouds over the border, so that the rain meant for the Union fell on Los Vales. The Union called it theft. Twenty years later [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2832655][color=#7FDBFF]the Charter[/color][/url][color=white] made it property: whoever seeds a cloud owns its rain.[/color]
[/td][/tr][/table]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]HOW THE WATER WAR WAS FOUGHT[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]In 2041 AquaVale dammed the Colorado, the last great river crossing the border, in [/color][color=white][b]Dry Gate[/b][/color][color=white]. The next year it went further: in [/color][color=white][b]Cloudbreak[/b][/color][color=white] it seeded the clouds over the border so that the rain meant for the Union fell in Los Vales.[/color]

[color=white]The Union struck back in 2042. In [/color][color=white][b]Spillway[/b][/color][color=white] its aircraft bombed an AquaVale dam, and the water washed away whole towns downstream: 5,100 civilians died in one night. In 2043 WM defended the remaining dams in [/color][color=white][b]Riverguard[/b][/color][color=white], and the Union lost 1,900 soldiers before it stopped. The river is still dammed.[/color]

[size=130][color=#8FE3FF][b]THE WALL[/b][/color][/size]

[color=white]Since 2084 famine inside the Union has pushed millions toward the border. The Union built the [/color][color=white][b]Wall[/b][/color][color=white] to keep its people in; Los Vales calls it the Wall of the East and lets [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Lockwell[/color][/url][color=white] sell "work visas" to whoever crosses. The labor camps of the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=2830623][color=#7FDBFF]Escaldar[/color][/url][color=white] have doubled. [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Cerberus[/color][/url][color=white] hacks the Union’s border systems; the Union accuses Los Vales of human trafficking. Meanwhile the [/color][url=https://www.nationstates.net/page=dispatch/id=1999868][color=#7FDBFF]Meridian Trust[/color][/url][color=white] holds old United States debt that the Union refuses to pay, and has frozen American assets all over the world.[/color]
